# Open BRX: the BRX manual

> A manual for the Battle Company BRX laser tagger and headset, and the open-source software that runs games on stock BRX guns. Only confirmed facts are published. Source: https://github.com/tony99nyr/open-brx

Every page is also plain Markdown at the same URL with a .md suffix. The whole manual in one file: https://open-brx.iamrossi.workers.dev/llms-full.txt

Protocol discovery credit: LaserTagMods (JEDGE / JBOX). Open BRX is independent and not endorsed by Battle Company.
